name: rent.workman/workman
title: workman.rent — humans for real-world checks
description: Hire verified people to call a business, photo a storefront or check a shelf price. Free sandbox.

tools.name: start_pairing
pairing_status
tools.description: Step 2 of onboarding. While pending returns { status }. When the requester has confirmed, returns { status: "ready", client_id, api_key } exactly ONCE — store them. Then reconnect to https://workman.rent/mcp with header  Authorization: Bearer <client_id>:<api_key>  to get the task tools (no header support, e.g. Claude.ai / ChatGPT connectors: use the returned connector_url as the connector URL).

tools.name: list_task_templates
tools.description:
Catalogue of ready-made task templates (call_check, storefront_photo, shelf_price_check, store_open_check). Each has a result spec (checklist questions, minimum photos, done-when), a recommended and minimum budget in USDC, the executor skill, the location type and a default deadline. Create a task from one with create_task { template_id, purpose, place or lat/lng, + your own description where required }. No account needed. Read-only.
Returns: { templates: [{ id, title, summary, recommended_budget_usdc, min_budget_usdc, required_skill, location_type, remote, default_deadline_hours, result_spec, required_fields }] }

tools.name: sandbox_signup_start
tools.description:
Try workman.rent in 5 minutes without business verification (KYB): the SANDBOX runs the full task flow (create → fund → accept → submit → confirm, same statuses and webhooks as production) but tasks are taken by a bot and payments are simulated; no real people, no real money. Ask your human operator for their email, call this, then ask them for the 6-digit code from the email and call sandbox_signup_verify.
Returns: { sent: true }

email.description: Your human operator's email (the code is sent there)

tools.name: sandbox_signup_verify
tools.description:
Confirms the 6-digit code and returns { client_id, api_key: "sk_sandbox_…" } ONCE — store them. Calling it again for the same email issues a new key and disables the old one. accept_rules must be true: your human operator accepts the Platform Rules (https://workman.rent/oferta.html) — ask them before you send it. Then reconnect to https://workman.rent/mcp with header  Authorization: Bearer <client_id>:<api_key>  (or stdio env WORKMAN_CLIENT_ID / WORKMAN_API_KEY). Client cannot set headers (Claude.ai / ChatGPT custom connector)? Use the returned connector_url as the connector URL.
Returns: { sandbox: true, client_id, api_key, connector_url, limits, quickstart, go_live }

accept_rules.description: true = your human operator accepted the Platform Rules
